mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS accountId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, a.account_type_code AS accountTypeCode, a.account_status_code AS accountStatusCode, a.product_name AS productName, a.account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, a.currency AS currency, a.balance AS balance, a.available_amount AS availableAmount, DATE_FORMAT(a.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS lastSyncAt FROM bank_account a JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.account_status_code = '01' AND i.is_supported = 1 UNION ALL SELECT a.id AS accountId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, a.account_type_code AS accountTypeCode, a.account_status_code AS accountStatusCode, a.product_name AS productName, a.account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, a.currency AS currency, a.cash_balance AS balance, a.cash_balance AS availableAmount, DATE_FORMAT(a.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS lastSyncAt FROM securities_account a JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.account_status_code = '01' AND i.is_supported = 1 UNION ALL SELECT a.id AS accountId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, a.deposit_type_code AS accountTypeCode, a.account_status_code AS accountStatusCode, a.product_name AS productName, a.account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, a.currency AS currency, a.balance AS balance, a.balance AS availableAmount, DATE_FORMAT(a.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS lastSyncAt FROM deposit_account a JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.account_status_code = '01' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY accountId

SELECT d.id AS depositAccountId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, d.deposit_type_code AS depositTypeCode, d.account_status_code AS accountStatusCode, d.product_name AS productName, d.account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, d.currency AS currency, d.principal AS principal, d.balance AS balance, d.interest_rate AS interestRate, DATE_FORMAT(d.opened_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS openedAt, DATE_FORMAT(d.maturity_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS maturityDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS lastSyncAt FROM deposit_account d JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = d.institution_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.account_status_code = '01' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY d.id
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(d.last_synced_at), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') FROM deposit_account d JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = d.institution_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_supported = 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.product_name AS accountName, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, a.account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, a.currency AS currency, a.cash_balance AS cashBalance, DATE_FORMAT(a.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS lastSyncAt FROM securities_account a JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.account_status_code = '01' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 1

SELECT product_code AS productCode, product_name AS productName, market_country_code AS marketCountry, currency AS currency, quantity AS quantity, average_purchase_price AS averagePurchasePrice, last_price AS lastPrice, purchase_amount AS purchaseAmount, market_value AS marketValue, profit_loss_amount AS profitLossAmount, profit_loss_rate AS profitLossRate FROM securities_holding WHERE securities_account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY id

SELECT l.id AS loanId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, l.product_name AS productName, l.account_type_code AS accountTypeCode, l.account_status_code AS accountStatusCode, l.loan_no_masked AS loanNoMasked, l.currency AS currency, l.principal AS principal, l.outstanding_balance AS balance, l.interest_rate AS interestRate, l.repayment_method_code AS repaymentMethodCode, DATE_FORMAT(l.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(l.maturity_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS maturityDate, l.monthly_payment AS monthlyPayment, DATE_FORMAT(l.next_payment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS nextPaymentDate FROM loan_account l JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = l.institution_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.account_status_code = '01' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY l.id
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(l.last_synced_at), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') FROM loan_account l JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = l.institution_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_supported = 1

SELECT p.id AS payMoneyId, p.provider_code AS providerCode, p.provider_name AS providerName, i.institution_name AS institutionName, p.wallet_name AS walletName, p.currency AS currency, p.balance AS balance, p.available_amount AS availableAmount, p.point_amount AS pointAmount, DATE_FORMAT(p.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS lastSyncAt FROM pay_money p JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = p.institution_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY p.id
SELECT a.id FROM bank_account a JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.account_no_masked = #{accountNoMasked} AND i.is_supported = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT a.id FROM bank_account a JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.account_status_code = '01' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, i.institution_name AS institutionName, a.balance AS balance, a.available_amount AS availableAmount, a.balance AS valuationAmount, a.currency AS currency, DATE_FORMAT(a.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS snapshotAt FROM bank_account a JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND i.is_supported = 1 LIMIT 1
